title: Alahambra's Best Tour Guide - - - Christian of My top Tours
text:
My Top Tour was a bit difficult to find at first, but it was absolutely worth the effort. We were dropped off near the coffee shop entrance, only to discover that the meeting location had been changed. Since I'm not very familiar with WhatsApp, it took me a little while to locate the updated meeting point.
Once we found the correct location for the English-speaking group, everything went smoothly.
Our tour guide, Christian, was a wonderful young man and truly the best guide you could hope for on this tour. He was engaging, energetic, and incredibly knowledgeable about the Alhambra. Beyond that
